claims.disproof_condition: 條件：金像電的重大訊息或財報寫出處分或提前賣回所持尖點私募可轉債、終止與尖點的合作，或尖點財報的關係人交易與主要客戶表寫出對它的營收大幅下滑。核查頻率：每季（尖點財報主要客戶與關係人附註；金像電重大訊息）。觸發後 48 小時：重寫尖點敘事「客戶為什麼選它」與鑽針層讀圖的買方段。
claims.statement: Customer-side (Gold Circuit Electronics material information, 2026-04-16): Gold Circuit will subscribe up to NT$200 million of Topoint Technology's private unsecured convertible bonds, stating the purpose as consolidating the supply-chain relationship and strengthening cooperation. A buyer paying into its supplier's financing; the filing does not mention drill bits.
